The Doorstep Groom

No car rides.
No waiting room.
Just bubbles.

Mobile grooming takes the stress out of the day: for your pet, and for you. Here's how a visit from Barks & Bubbles works.

i

Reach out

Call, text, email, or send the request form. Tell Danielle about your pet, their coat, and anything that makes them nervous.

ii

We pull up

Barks & Bubbles comes to your home in San Marco or the surrounding area. Your pet never leaves the neighborhood.

iii

One-on-one

A full-service groom with all of Danielle's attention on your pet: no kennels, no crowd, no barking line-up.

iv

Fresh & home

Your pet comes back to your door clean, fluffy, and ready for their close-up.

Fresh off the table
  • 01

    Calmer for anxious pets

  • 02

The Grooming Menu

From first suds to final fluff.

Every groom is full-service and planned around your pet's breed, coat, and comfort. Here's the kind of work you'll find on Danielle's table.

01 · Bath

Bubbles & blow-out

The "bubbles" in Barks & Bubbles. A thorough wash and dry for a pup that looks and smells brand new.

02 · Cut

Cut & style

Breed trims, teddy faces, round bichon heads, and tidy terriers, styled with 15+ years of practice behind the shears.

03 · Flair

A little extra

Bandanas, festive looks, and creative color for pets with big personalities. Ask what's possible for yours.

Pricing is personal. Each pet is quoted on size, coat, and needs. Reach out for yours.
